text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"Trending on Social Media! C-I-C-A<n>Extract
Ampoules That Leave Your<n>Skin Ultra Moist and
Supple!" ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Cica? Ampoule? Booster? Ohh, I bet a<n>city girl could
make sense of this<n>mumbo jumbo. O-okay then...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Mr. Smartphone, I need your help!<n>Save me with
that super search<n>magic of yours!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"A booster refers to a balancing<n>serum..." Balancing
serum? What's<n>that?
